steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('hotel'), F = s.frame; const p = F.w(0, 3.0); G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(p.x, p.z); N.controller.setPose(p.x, p.z, F.yaw(0), -0.05); return 1; })()

(() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('hotel'), F = s.frame; const a = F.v(-5.95, 1.75, -10.7); const C = N.controller; C.yaw = Math.atan2(-(a.x - G.eye.x), -(a.z - G.eye.z)); C.pitch = Math.atan2(a.y - G.eye.y, Math.hypot(a.x - G.eye.x, a.z - G.eye.z)); return 1; })()

(() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('hotel'), F = s.frame; const p = { x: N.controller.pos.x, z: N.controller.pos.z }; const l = F.l(p.x, p.z); return JSON.stringify({ me: [+l.x.toFixed(2), +l.z.toFixed(2)], gy: +N.controller.groundY.toFixed(2), lvl: G.city.places.level, inside: G.city.places.inside && G.city.places.inside.id, near: G.stage.colliders.near(p.x, p.z, 0.6).filter((o) => !o.gone).map((o) => ({ tag: o.tag, lvl: o.lvl, c: o.cx != null ? [+F.l(o.cx, o.cz).x.toFixed(2), +F.l(o.cx, o.cz).z.toFixed(2)] : [+F.l(o.x, o.z).x.toFixed(2), +F.l(o.x, o.z).z.toFixed(2)], h: o.hx != null ? [+o.hx.toFixed(2), +o.hz.toFixed(2), +(o.angle || 0).toFixed(2)] : o.r })) }); })()
(() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('hotel'), F = s.frame; N.controller.yaw = F.yaw(-Math.PI / 2); N.controller.pitch = 0; return 1; })()

(() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('hotel'), F = s.frame; const p = { x: N.controller.pos.x, z: N.controller.pos.z }; const l = F.l(p.x, p.z); return JSON.stringify({ me: [+l.x.toFixed(2), +l.z.toFixed(2)], frozen: N.controller.frozen, mode: N.controller.mode, vel: [N.controller.vel.x, N.controller.vel.z].map((v) => +v.toFixed(2)), all: G.stage.colliders.near(p.x, p.z, 0.8).map((o) => ({ tag: o.tag, gone: !!o.gone, lvl: o.lvl, c: o.cx != null ? [+F.l(o.cx, o.cz).x.toFixed(2), +F.l(o.cx, o.cz).z.toFixed(2)] : [+F.l(o.x, o.z).x.toFixed(2), +F.l(o.x, o.z).z.toFixed(2)], h: o.hx != null ? [+o.hx.toFixed(2), +o.hz.toFixed(2)] : o.r })), cast: G.stage.cast.list.map((c) => [c.name, +F.l(c.pos.x, c.pos.z).x.toFixed(1), +F.l(c.pos.x, c.pos.z).z.toFixed(1)]) }); })()
